summary: Final QA pass for Wetworks CRM after iter6 fixes (secret_key masking, _phase4_migrate after /seed, DialogDescription sr-only). Backend regression: 114/114 PASS across all 6 phases. Frontend: login (email + 'Email or Mobile' label), invalid-cred toast, RBAC redirects for Sales/Technician on /settings/*, all sidebar testids resolve including child nav-roles/users/vehicle-management/system-settings, mobile responsiveness verified at 375x812 with 0 horizontal overflow on 10 critical pages, hamburger drawer opens, System Settings shows 4 tabs (toggles/payment-providers/whatsapp/smtp), 0 console errors, 0 DialogContent aria-describedby warnings (fix from iter6 confirmed working). secret_key masking fix verified end-to-end via curl: PUT /api/system-settings/integrations/tap with {api_key,secret_key} returns BOTH masked (• present) on PUT response AND on subsequent GET /system-settings.

minor.issue: Returns 200 to technician role (no role-gate on read endpoints); UI is gated via PrivateRoute redirect, but a technician token can still read these resources via direct API call. Low priority for this CRM since data is non-sensitive, but consider adding require_roles dependency on these read endpoints if multi-tenant or sensitive deployments are planned.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Add require_roles(['admin','sales']) on read endpoints like GET /api/customers and GET /api/roles if technician should not read them via direct API. Currently UI redirects but token-level access exists.

(Optional, deferred from iter3) server.py is 2439 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, customers, vehicles, quotations, jobs, inventory, services, system_settings, reports) for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: _mask_integration predicate now correctly catches secret_key via SECRET_KEYS literal AND startswith('secret_') guard — verified via live curl: PUT and GET both return the masked value with • characters.
_phase4_migrate is now called after both startup and /seed (re)seeding; Administrator role is idempotently upserted with all 14 permission keys; admin@autocrm.kw is_master=true confirmed.
DialogDescription sr-only fix confirmed effective — 0 React aria-describedby warnings across Roles/Users/VehicleManagement/SystemSettings dialogs in console capture during navigation.
Frontend mobile design is solid: scrollWidth == clientWidth (375px) on every page tested — no horizontal overflow, dialogs use w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)] pattern as documented.

RBAC redirect: Sales and Technician users hitting /settings/roles, /settings/users, /settings/vehicle-management, /settings via direct URL are correctly redirected to / (dashboard) by PrivateRoute. Sidebar correctly hides the entire Settings group for non-admin roles.
Mobile login backend accepts mobile or email in same field; verified email-login still works end-to-end from UI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows pass; 0 console errors; 0 aria warnings; 0 mobile overflows)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create+cleanup all TEST_-prefixed records. UI test left a dialog open and Save Customer didn't fire (locator hit Name field with bad value) — no record was persisted. tap integration was set then disabled+cleared via curl as cleanup. whatsapp_enabled toggle confirmed OFF in final state.

Mobile: hamburger via mobile-nav-btn opens mobile-sidebar, mobile-nav-overlay backdrop closes. Login page label is 'EMAIL OR MOBILE'. No retest needed unless new features land.
